# supervisor-done-count

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Per-row done-count chip on a supervisor's conversation (its task states the supervisor mandate): how many tasks of the supervisor's tree are done, with a ring filled by the done share of the whole tree; hover for done / running / dropped.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Item.Chips` → `SupervisorDoneCountChip`
  - Uses:
    - `conversations/conversation-ui/item.Item`
    - `network/live.mapRow`
    - `network/live.useLive`
    - `network/live/live-state.ResourceErrorInline`
    - `primitives/css/badge.Badge`
    - `tasks.useTask`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Uses tokens:
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --muted-foreground`
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --success`
    - `ui/tokens/shape --spacing`
